items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I used to play snare drums sometimes with Tony Spago at the Dixieland Band and Biloxi

ctx.x: I used to play snare drums sometimes with Tony Spago at the Dixieland Band and Biloxi in the Crockett Parade. He'd say, Bruno, take my drums, I'm tired. He's playing with, he's with the original New Orleans Dixieland Jazz Band. He plays the kazoo.
Yeah, still in New York I guess, yeah.
